en: Sepia-toned street scene showing a market square with people walking and children playing. A large church with an onion-shaped dome tower dominates the left side, with bare trees in front. Lined along the right side are multi‑story townhouses with shops at street level; signs hang from the buildings and striped poles extend above the street. Horse-drawn carts and groups of townspeople are visible in the distance. The printed caption at the top reads 'Olbernhau i. Erzgeb. Markt'.
